learnings: Outline_Shader_* slots are INVERTED HULL. A name-matched outline MI on them renders as expanded shards, not a silhouette. The 'obviously correct' name match is wrong here — do not redo it.
SBW_MELUSINA_006/007 = skin, NOT bodice. The grey torso garment is a different slot, still unidentified.
The bodice albedo T_Melusina_M_Melusina_BaseColor is a BLANK 4096x4096 WHITE map — it is also the skin albedo. Grey torso is a missing bake, not a tint problem.
Colour is driven by the Albedo TEXTURE, not BaseTint. MI_Melusina_Hair binds no albedo so it fell back to the master default (T_Marble_7), which is why tuning BaseTint did nothing.

ROOT CAUSE of the recurring 'saved: False': .gitattributes marks *.uasset lockable, and git-lfs sets lockable files read-only when unlocked (lfs.setlockablereadonly defaults true). Any git touch re-applies it. Either git lfs lock before editing, or clear read-only immediately before every save.
